I’ve been an adult for all of it; I’ve had a front row seat for two decades of moral panics, parental freakouts, and bizarre political theater. The games and the broader culture’s reaction to them have changed dramatically in that time. In 2001, newscasters worried GTA III was training an army of young men to kill. articles.summary: OpenAI put a new rule in place that gives the company more control over how much of the world — including China — can access its AI models. Gateways and routers that provide third-party access to OpenAI’s tech now need the company’s review and approval . Such gateways, the most prominent of which is OpenRouter, have become increasingly popular with developers and companies seeking access to a wide range of AI models: Instead of individual contracts with each lab, one account with a router can let you access hundreds of models from the US, Europe, and China. Beyond the technical details, the move has implications in the global AI race. US security agencies and companies, including Anthropic, have accused Chinese AI labs of distilling, or copying, American frontier models by routing requests through intermediaries that resell access to their models, which obscures the identity of the end user. Those cases largely involved gray-market resellers, known in China as “transfer stations,” but OpenAI’s new rule extends its oversight to any service standing between it and the people using its models. — J.D.
